body_change.reason: Bed-rooted fin search could not reach these local native starts without body collision. The continuous underside chamfer is anchored to actual previous-layer printed bead footprints and extends until its plane fully clears the local region. Only small underside corners are trimmed; actual neighboring hardware actual neighboring hardware envelopes are protected; for nuts, central planar bearing and anti-rotation faces are protected and any corner relief needs separate face-by-face retention checks. Washer-entry chamfers are accepted only after retaining at least 98% of contact area and the entire outer 1 mm bearing ring and depth.

registered_reference.method: Rigid registration of the original congruent donor reference. Both frozen target vertices and triangle centers are checked against the registered reference and vice versa. No design dimension is intentionally changed. Exact donor print meshes are retained to avoid Boolean triangulation artifacts.

geometry.label: exact64
geometry.removal_policy: Fins have no downward-facing area above the build plate, hence every fin column continues to the bed. After severing the short teeth they can withdraw toward the bed without crossing the unchanged part. Empty functional clearances must be completely cleaned before assembly.

fit.label: exact64

registered_congruent_reference.method: Rigid registration of the original congruent donor reference. Both frozen target vertices and triangle centers are checked against the registered reference and vice versa. No design dimension is intentionally changed. Exact donor print meshes are retained to avoid Boolean triangulation artifacts.

fit.baseline_body_policy: Frozen F3 print mesh is authoritative. Recorded bed and owner transforms register it against the unchanged assembly hardware. Differences from regenerated assembly body are reported, not attributed to this change.
fit.proof_scope: New body is a subset of the validated computational reference in the same rigid coordinate frame. A registered_congruent_reference, when present, uses an independently measured congruent source boundary within 0.0001 mm to avoid a second numerically unstable Boolean regeneration; its frozen source and printed reference hashes are verified. Where nominal_reference_recovery is present, the reference is the unchanged analytic O22 CAD with separately measured sub-0.0001 mm boundary agreement to the frozen print mesh. This proves no new geometric interference under any rigid pose. It does not prove stress/fatigue equivalence or the retention of every contact; actual assembly contacts and axis-limit samples are separately listed.

qualified_small_nut_corner_reliefs.scope: Within a 0.08 mm clearance band outside every nut planar face with original surrounding material, retain at least 98% of material and preserve the face core 0.15 mm from its edges. This protects nominal flat spacing and bearing centers, without claiming a load test.

qualified_magnet_retention_entry_reliefs.criteria: Magnet-cap M2 nuts only, independently identified by matching magnet_screw hardware. Entire screw-facing bearing footprint and existing material through 1 mm remain unchanged. Opposite unloaded entry-face band retains >=95% and its 0.15 mm inset core, with >=70% of existing 1 mm backing. Anti-rotation flats retain >=99% through 0.5 mm and their 0.25 mm inset cores. Screw and nut geometry/position are unchanged. This is geometry screening, not a strength/creep test.
qualified_magnet_retention_entry_reliefs.source_design_evidence: cad/revO15/twist.py: sensor-cap M2x4 screws and magnet_nut pockets; radial M3 brake and captured rotor collar are separate.
